environment.description: Same Kafka consumer deployed on EKS. The file-upload-events topic is populated exclusively via an Amazon API Gateway (HTTP API) integration with a Kafka REST proxy. The API Gateway route POST /api/v1/files/upload has a request validator attached with a JSON Schema model that enforces: (1) 'filename' must match pattern '^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,64}\.(jpg|png|gif|pdf|docx)$', (2) 'content_type' must be one of enum ['image/jpeg','image/png','image/gif','application/pdf','application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document'], (3) 'content' must be a string with maxLength 5242880, (4) 'user_id' must match pattern '^[a-f0-9]{8}-[a-f0-9]{4}-4[a-f0-9]{3}-[89ab][a-f0-9]{3}-[a-f0-9]{12}$'. The validator mode is set to 'ALL' (validates both body and parameters). Messages that fail schema validation receive 400 and are never produced to Kafka. The API Gateway is the ONLY producer authorized on the topic via Kafka ACLs (mTLS client certificate pinned to the gateway's service identity).

config.api_gateway: Amazon API Gateway HTTP API with request validation enabled
config.kafka_acl: only API Gateway service identity (mTLS) can produce to file-upload-events topic
